tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: tshe sgrub rdo rje'i phreng ba las: tshe bdag yab yum sras gsum gyi: phyi sgrub rgyud kyi phrin las bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈ tshe bdag rig 'dzin rnams la 'dud: tshe rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las: gdams ngag mang po gnad du bsdus: skal ldan rje 'bangs rnams la bshad: spros na rgya che bsam yas kyang: mdor dril rgyud lung man ngag gsum: thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i lam: rgyud don tshe bdag yab yum sras: lung lugs zhi khro stong lnga brgya: man ngag tshe sbyin dkar mor bsdus: spros na re re la yang gsum: thog mar dge ba tshe yi bdag: yab yum sras gsum sgrub pa'i thabs: phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang bzhi: gang zag blo yi rim par bstan: sa ma ya: phyi sgrub gnas dus shis pa la: rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad bkram: bde ba'i stan 'dug rnam g.yeng spang: lus sems khong klod mos gus bskyed: sngon dngos rjes kyis nyams su len: sngon 'gro rgyud sbyong rim pa gsum: na mo: dkon mchog kun 'dus rigs brgya'i bdag: bla ma bcom ldan tshe dpag med: tshe lha rig 'dzin tshogs bcas la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas sar 'god phyir: bdag gis 'chi med mchog bsgrub na: tshe dpag med pa'i sku gsung thugs: myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshe bdag yab yum sras 'khor bcas: 'dir gshegs brtan bzhugs gus phyag 'tshal: mchod sprin 'bul zhing sdig ltung bshags: rjes su yi rang chos 'khor bskul: bzhugs gsol dge kun byang chub bsngo: bdag gzhan 'chi med mngon 'grub shog: 'gal rkyen bar chad bsal ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i zhing: 'khrul rtog bgegs kyi ming yang med: snod bcud lha sngags ye shes ngang: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: mthun rkyen byin rlabs dbab pa ni: hrī: rang byung bde chen pho brang nas: pad+ma tshe yi lha tshogs kyis: sku gsung thugs kyis byin chen phob: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog skur: ngo mtshar rtags dang mtshan ma ston: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol:

badz+ra ā yu ṣe dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: chos dbyings ngang las rang byung ba'i: kun bzang rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig rdzas: 'dod yon zag med gter du gyur: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye ā hūm̐: pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta sa ma ye hūm̐: badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: dngos gzhi bskyed bzlas rdzogs pa gsum: dam tshig bskyed cing ye shes bstim: mchod bstod yan lag rdzogs bya ste: a: 'khor 'das chos kun gdod ma nas: skye 'gag gnas dmigs 'gro 'ong bral: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom: tshad med rnam bzhi 'gro la snang: zung 'jug rgyu yi oṃ dkar po: 'od 'phros snod bcud dbyings su sbyangs: e yaṃ ra suṃ bh+rūm̐ raṃ bh+rūm̐: 'od zhu 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang: rin chen ri rab srung 'khor nang: mtshan rdzogs sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus: pad+ma 'dab bzhi 'od lnga dang: rin chen pad+ma'i phreng ba spel: dbus kyi ze'u 'brur zla gdan la: oṃ las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus bcom ldan tshe dpag med: dkar gsal ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog: mnyam gzhag 'chi med tshe bum bsnams: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan: skyil krung 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs: thugs las hūm̐ āṃḥhrīḥdang khroṃ: phyogs bzhi'i 'dab bzhir 'phros pa las: g.yas su sras mchog thugs rje che: dkar dmar pad phreng tshe bum bsnams: dar gyi na bza' rin chen rgyan: phyed skyil zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: g.yon du tshe yum tsaṇ+ḍa lī: dkar dmar rdor dril tshe bum bsnams: dar dang rin chen pad phreng brgyan: nyi steng pad+ma'i skyil krung bzhugs: mdun du dbang chen rta mchog dpal: shel mdog pad+ma tshe bum bsnams: 'bar ba'i chas ldan rta zhal 'tsher: 'dor thabs nyi gdan me klong 'gying: rgyab tu gdon 'dul nam mkha' lding: dung mdog lcags kyu tshe bum bsnams:

gnam lcags mchu sder spu gri'i sgro: nyi gdan ye shes me klong bzhugs: gtso 'khor gnas gsum yi ge gsum: rdo rje gsum du lhun gyis grub: spyi bor dpa' bo 'bru lngas brgyan: rigs lngas dbang bskur gdod nas rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: 'gyur med bde chen chos kyi dbyings: rang byung ye shes pho brang nas: 'chi med mgon po tshe dpag med: shes rab yum mchog sras dang bcas: sprul pa phyag brnyan mthu rtsal can: tshe lha rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams: tshe dbang dngos grub mchog stsol phyir: thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: snying rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam bskul: byams pa'i zhags pas spyan drangs te: dga' ba'i sgrog gis mi phyed bsdam: btang snyoms dril bus dgyes pa bskyed: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te ā hūm̐: oṃ: rdo rje'i gsang ba rmad po che: 'gro don rang bzhin rdzogs par ldan: thabs shes zung 'jug 'bar ba'i sku: cir yang sprul la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na mā mi: hrī: lag gnyis las kyi phyag rgya bcing: chos rgya gsang ba ngag tu brjod: dam tshig ye shes yid kyis bsgom: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥkhrauṃ ma hā mu dra pū dza ho: oṃ: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis: srid pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas sprul: hrī: byams pa spos kyi sprin lding zhing: snying rje rin chen me tog 'thor: dga' ba chos kyi mar me 'bar: btang snyoms bdud rtsi'i dri char 'beb: yul dbang thabs dang shes rab dang: zung 'jug bde ba'i dgyes mchod 'bul: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga dhū pe puṣ+pe ā lo ke gan+dhe pū dza ho: hrī: snang zhing grags pa'i chos rnams ni:

rang byung 'dod yon rin chen gter: zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud dang ldan: dbang po lnga yi rgyan du rol: pañca kā ma gu ṇa pū dza ho: hrī: yid 'ong mdzes pa'i lha mo ni: mgrin par snyan pa'i glu len cing: rkang pa rdo rje'i gar stabs sgyur: bde chen ye shes rol mos mchod: ma hā su kha pū dza ho: hrī: dug lnga rnam dag bdud rtsi sman: khams gsum bsgral ba rak+ta'i bcud: dug gsum rtsad gcod ba liṃ ta: sku gsung thugs kyi klong du bzhes: sarba pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hrī: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: kha sbyor bde chen 'du 'bral med: 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang: sgrol ba don gyi cho ga rdzogs: dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku la bstod: bde chen rab 'bar tsaṇ+ḍa lī: gzhom med gsung gi ngo bor bstod: ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba'i sras: thugs mchog spyan ras gzigs la bstod: dngos grub kun bdag yon tan mdzod: rta mchog dbang gi rgyal por bstod: mthu stobs rtsal ldan nam mkha' lding: bgegs 'dul phrin las mdzad la bstod: ye shes 'dod rgur sgyur ba yis: sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i rol mo ni: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul dra bar ston: 'chi med dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: ho: bdag sogs ma rig dbang gyur pas: 'di dang gtan du sgrib pa'i gegs: nongs pa gang mchis 'gyod pas bshags: tshangs par mdzad nas dngos grub mchog: sku gsung thugs la gang mchis pa: da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol: ces dang yi ge brgya pa brjod: bzlas pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum ste: sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes bsnyen: yab sras thugs kar zla ba dang: yum thugs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la: oṃ dkar hūm̐ mthing āḥdamar mdangs: rang sngags phreng bas g.yas g.yon bskor: 'od 'phros don byas byin rlabs bsdus: rang la thim pas rtog sgrib sbyangs: tshe dang ye shes mchog thob

bsam: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: oṃ dhā ki tsan+ḍa lī ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ a yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: dbang chen yon tan dngos grub sgrub: rta mchog thugs kar nyi steng hrī: sngags phreng dkar gsal g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer lcags kyus 'khor 'das kyi: dwangs bcud bsdus nas thim par bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca oṃ: ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭha oṃ: phrin las mkha' lding las la sbyar: khyung chen thugs kar nyi steng khroṃ: sngags phreng 'od dang sprul pa spros: tshe bdud bar chad lhag med bcom: bla tshe brkus phrogs chad nyams rnams: nṛ bh+rūm̐ a yi rnam par bsdus: bdag thim rdo rje'i tshe thob bsam: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṇa hūm̐: tshe bh+rūm̐ dza: g.yu bh+rūm̐ dza: ā yur+dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha oṃ: bsnyen pa cha gsum sgrub pa gnyis: las sbyor gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: mdun bskyed bsgrub na tshe 'brang sogs: rten bsham phrin las dus bzhir gtang: bzlas pa bya zhing tshogs mchod 'bul: mda' dar g.yab cing tshe bcud 'gugs: oṃ: bcom ldan sku yi 'od zer gyis: phung po lnga yi tshe nyams na: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i byin rlabs khug: gdos bcas dwangs ma 'od du smin: mi shigs 'chi med rdo rje'i skur: phyag rgya lnga yi rgyas thobs shig: ā: yum chen gsung gi 'od zer gyis: 'byung ba lnga yi tshe nyams na: dbyings phyug yum lnga'i byin rlabs khug: srog rtsol 'pho ba dbu mar stims: gzhom med rdo rje'i gsung dbyangs la: rang byung yi ge'i rgyas thobs shig: hūm̐: sras mchog thugs kyi 'od zer gyis: 'khor lo lnga yi tshe nyams na: ye shes rnam lnga'i byin rlabs khug: 'khrul rtog ye grol chos kyi dbyings: gdod nas mi 'gyur rdo rje'i thugs: bde chen 'od gsal rgyas thobs shig:

hrī: rta mchog dbang gi pho nya spros: phyogs bzhi'i gdon gyis tshe phrogs na: phyag rgya bzhi yis rang gnas khug: bla tshe srog dbugs nyams pa gsos: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: khro chung tshogs kyi rgyas thobs shig: khroṃ: gtum chen khyung gi pho nya spros: steng 'og gdon gyis bla khyer na: myur mgyogs rtsal gyis skad cig khug: bla srog dbang thang rang sor chud: mtshon cha rnam lnga'i gur khang la: bskal me 'bar ba'i rgyas thobs shig: ces bskul skabs su 'dod don gsol: kye: 'chi med dbang po tshe yi bdag: yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa la: rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: dus min 'chi ba zlog tu gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'grub par mdzod: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca sarba sid+dhi a la la ho: zhes bskul tshe yi sgrub rdzas rol: sa ma ya: rdzogs rim thugs srog 'od zer gyis: snod bcud kun zhu rang la thim: rang lus pha lam las grub pa'i: rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga'i lter: nyi zla'i gwa 'ur oṃ āḥhūm̐: rwa rtse yar mar sbubs gnyis su: khroṃ dang hrīḥs mtshan rang 'od 'bar: sems gtad ye shes rlung sbyong gis: 'bru gsum 'od zer 'khor 'das khyab: thams cad 'od lnga'i rnam par zhu: gwa 'u'i yig 'bru la thim pas: sgo gsum gdod nas rang byung gi: rdo rje gsum dngos grub par bsam: yid dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya: mthar ni lus sems nam mkhar bsre: 'dzin med gnas lugs rang bab bskyang: thun mtshams rang lus rdo rjer bsgom: 'chi med gnyug mar gding bcas ste: skye 'chi'i rtog pa zil gyis mnan: nges par brtson na myur 'grub 'gyur: rjes kyi bya ba gsum yin te: tshogs mchod dam rdzas tshogs par bsham: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: phyi snod pad gzhong yangs pa ru: nang bcud rdo rje'i dam tshig rdzas:

'chi med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi: 'dod yon sprin phung 'phro bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: oṃ: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing: rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil: ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul: tshogs mchog dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol: e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dza: oṃ: bla med mchog gi mchod pa ni: ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas brgyan te: dam tshig bzhin du 'bul gyis bzhes: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: ho: bdag cag sgo gsum nongs pa dang: bag med rgyal ba'i bka' las 'das: sgrib par gyur pa gang lags pa: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: sa ma ya shud+dhe a: e yaṃ: sarba nṛ tri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa'i tshogs: dgra bgegs bkug ste mtshon chas bsgral: dug gsum dbyings su bstab par mdzod: mā ra ya phaṭa: māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog: byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa: sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod: ta na ga ṇa pū dza ho: bza' btung rol cing glu gar bya: lhag ma bdud rtsir byin brlabs te: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong dur khrod nyul: lhag la dbang ba'i dam can rnams: tshogs lhag bdud rtsi'i bshal chu bzhes: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod: a mṛta uts+tshiṣ+ṭa khā hi: lhag chad kha bskang nongs pa bshags: rtag chad mtha' bsal rgyun spyod bya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum: 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs su thim: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: rang byung 'chi med rdo rje'i sku: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi go chas gtams: ci spyod ye shes rol pa'i ngang: dag pa'i snang ba lam du khyer: bsngo smon rgyas gdab shis pa brjod: bla med tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: sku gsung thugs su lhun gyis grub: 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas thob ste:

'gro kun sangs rgyas sar 'god shog: tshe dbang rig 'dzin brgyud gsum byin rlabs ldan: 'chi med lha mchog tshe yi dngos grub 'beb: sprul pa bka' sdod bgegs 'dul phrin las sgrub: rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: bskyed bzlas gtso bor bton pa la: rgyud dang mthun pa'i phrin las ni: nyung ngur bsdus te bstan pa 'o: sa ma ya: tshe yi dbang gis smin 'dod na: stegs bur dkyil 'khor legs par bzhengs: dbus su bum pa bcud ldan bkod: g.yas g.yon tshe ril tshe'i dza gad: mdun rgyab tshe 'brang mda' dar dang: mchod pa'i bye brag tshul bzhin bya: bdag mdun lhar gsal las gzhung bsrang: dbang rdzas gtso 'khor so sor dmigs: bzlas pa bya zhing tshe bcud bsdu: lha rnams 'od zhu rdzas su bsam: slob mar khrus byas bgegs bskrad la: phyag byas maṇ+ḍal phul nas su: gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe yi bdag: dbyer med rdo rje slob dpon bdag la dgongs: 'chi med sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: tshe yi dbang dang byin rlabs bstsal du gsol: ces pas lan gsum gsol ba gdab: yan lag bdun pas rgyud sbyangs la: lhar bskyed ye shes byin chen dbab: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya: de nas gtso bo'i ye shes kyis: byin brlabs bum pa spyi bor bzhag:

oṃ: bkra shis bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun: tshe dpag med mgon ye shes bcud du 'khyil: dbang bskur lus kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog: gtso bo'i snying po brjod pa'i mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: zhes btags bum chu lce la sbyin: yum gyi byang sems bde ba'i rgyun: tshe chang mgrin par bzhag cing myong: ā: pad+ma bhañjar tshe bdag tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i: bde chen 'byung ba'i bcud 'dus bdud rtsi'i rgyun: myang bas ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: gzhom med rdo rje'i gsung du 'grub par shog: yum gyi sngags mthar 'di btags sbyin: wā ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: sras mchog ngo bo 'khor 'das bcud: ril bu snying gar gtugs byas la: hūm̐: thabs shes nyi zla'i gwa 'ur 'khor 'das bcud: 'jig rten dbang phyug thig le'i gzugs su 'khyil: 'di zos yid kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: mi shigs rdo rje'i thugs su 'grub par shog: sras sngags sham la 'di brjod sbyin: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe 'brang rta mchog dbang gi sku: spyi bor bzhag pas byin gyis brlab: hrī: tshe 'brang zla gam dbang gi pho brang du: rta mchog byin rlabs 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun: khyod la thim pas sgo gsum sgrib kun dag: 'jigs med ye shes rdo rjer 'grub par shog: rta sngags sham du 'di nyid gdags: sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mda' dar g.yab la tshe 'gugs btang: khyung gis bgegs srung go bsgos bsam: khroṃ: khyung chen sprul pas tshe yi bcud bsdus shing: phyag rgya'i rgyas btab rdo rje'i go cha bgos: khong gseng rta khyung 'bar ba'i rdul gyis gtams: bar gcod bgegs kyis nam yang mi tshugs shog: khyung sngags sham bu bcas pa brjod: mda' dar gnas lngar rgya gram bkod: a: spros pas 'khor 'das khyab pa'i tshe yi bcud: bsdus pas snying po mi shigs thig ler 'dus: chos nyid byang chub sems su rgyas btab pas:

mi 'gyur rdo rje'i srog tu 'grub par shog: rab tu gnas pa'i sngags kyis brtan: me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod: byin rlabs ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis: dbang 'di lan gcig bskur bas kyang: 'chi bdag lo gsum nges par bzlog: tshe dang ye shes 'phel bar 'gyur: phyi ltar tshom bur bsgrub pa'i tshul: skal ldan don du bdag gis bstan: zab cing dngos grub myur ba'i lam: nyams su blangs pas don chen 'grub: yal bar ma dor gces par zungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
